text:
Sunny the rabbit’s would-be rescuers have solved most of the case.
They have established contact with the man believed to have
stolen her from a city animal shelter
— something the police said they had failed to do, four weeks into the investigation.
They learned that another man, seen on video with Sunny in Upper Manhattan, may have her.
But the rescuers do not know the whereabouts of the fluffy gray bunny.
And so their search continues.
“I’m not losing hope,” said Chris Allieri, a rabbit lover turned pet detective.
Sunny lived at the city shelter in East Harlem. On June 14, a man was turned down there when he tried to adopt a dog to join his two unneutered “guard dogs,” and he grabbed Sunny, apparently in retaliation.
